build.unavailable: Server build unavailable (offline or invalid response). You can keep playing or retry.
build.match: Server version {version} · Page and server report the same build.
build.unverified: Server version {version} · Development or unidentified build; comparison unavailable.
build.mismatch: This page and server are different builds. Reload to update when you are ready; this will reconnect your game.
lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.base_unit_hint: Creation only. Changing this value starts a new table.
lobby.base_unit_error: Base unit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
lobby.spectator_hint: Spectator mode: pick 4 bots to watch a full bot-vs-bot table.
lobby.creation_settings_hint: These choices configure a new table. Joining a table keeps its server settings.
hand.sort_hint: Automatic, on your screen only. Groups include four identical tiles; this does not claim a meld or suggest a scoring pattern. Relay games keep manual arrangement.
settings.mobile_table_status: Show table status on compact screens
settings.mobile_overlays_hint: Table status is hidden by default on phones and compact tablets. Open Move Log or Chat with their existing buttons; your panel choice is remembered and the hand stays clear. Turn, claim and pickup prompts stay visible. Desktop display is unchanged.
result_dialog.continue: Review the result, then Continue. The next hand waits for every human player.
result_dialog.pending: Sending your acknowledgement. Waiting for the server…
result_dialog.waiting: Acknowledged. Waiting for the other players: {players}.
result_dialog.advancing: Everyone is ready. Waiting for the server to start the next hand…
result_dialog.observer: The players must continue before the next hand. You can dismiss this result.
result_dialog.dismiss: You can dismiss this result. The server controls further progression.
result_dialog.reconnecting: Reconnecting or synchronizing. Your acknowledgement status will be restored from the server.
result_dialog.invalid: This result has incomplete continuation information. Refresh to reconnect; no acknowledgement was sent.
result_dialog.rejected: The server could not accept your acknowledgement: {reason}.
lobby.public_toggle_label: List this game in the public lobby
lobby.public.no_room: Start or join a table to manage its public listing.
lobby.public.unknown: This table was not found. It has not been created by this lookup.
lobby.public.identity: Verify your player identity by reconnecting before managing this table.
lobby.public.nonowner: Only this table's owner can change its public listing.
lobby.public.started: The game has started. Public listing changes are only available while waiting for players.
lobby.public.disconnected: Connect to this table and the online lobby to change its public listing.
lobby.public.not_allowed: The server has not granted permission to manage this listing.
lobby.public.unlisted: Not listed in the public lobby.
lobby.table_link_hint: A join-only table link without your seat, settings or reconnect token.
lobby.table_link_manual: Clipboard unavailable. Copy the selected table link manually.
room.identity_failed: Cannot connect without verified identity. Retry when the server is reachable. {reason}
room.connection_failed: Could not connect to the table: {reason}
room.join.room-not-found: This table no longer exists. Return to the lobby to choose another table. No new table was created.
room.join.room-full: This table has no open human seats. Return to the lobby to choose another table.
room.join.room-not-seating: This game has already started. Return to the lobby to find a table waiting for players.
actions.choice_hint: Only the server's legal options are shown. Cancel makes no declaration.
actions.unavailable: That action is no longer available. No declaration was sent.
actions.no_confirmation: No server confirmation received. Reload the table to refresh its state before trying again.
actions.claim_waiting: No claim result yet. Other players may still be deciding. Reloading refreshes the table without resending your claim.
settings.title: Settings
settings.rule_presets.preview_notice: Preview — rule presets don't affect gameplay yet (tracked in #130).
settings.perspective_hint: Uncheck for flat view. Applies immediately; P also switches views.
settings.voice.toggle: Enable voice chat for this table
settings.voice.hint: When enabled, players at this table can use voice chat.
settings.voice.permission: Voice settings require an authorized owner/admin account session. Guest ownership alone does not grant voice administration.
settings.voice.unavailable: Voice administration is disabled until server metadata is available.
settings.voice.refresh_failed: The voice request succeeded, but its current server setting could not be confirmed. Reconnect to refresh it.
chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholder: Say something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.unavailable_hint: Check your connection and table membership, then retry.
chat.empty_private: Pick a recipient to send a private message.
chat.command_help: /clear — clear the visible history. /help — show commands.
chat.join_table: Join a table to use room chat. Online players and invitations are available here in the lobby.
chat.identity_required: Chat needs a verified player identity (HTTP 401). Reconnect and retry.
chat.membership_required: This chat is not available to your current table membership or channel (HTTP 403).
chat.room_missing: Table chat was not found (HTTP 404). Check the table link or return to the lobby.
chat.http_failed: Chat request failed (HTTP {status}). Retry when the server is available.
chat.connect_first: Connect to this Changsha table before using room chat.
social.unavailable: Online lobby unavailable. The last roster may be out of date.
social.unavailable_reason: Online lobby unavailable; the last roster may be out of date. {reason}
social.load_failed: Could not load chat and invitations: {reason}
social.delivery_unavailable: This player is online but cannot currently receive invitations.
social.invite_need_table: Join a table with an open human seat to invite someone.
social.invite_sent: Invitation delivered to {player}. No seat is reserved.
social.invite_hint: Invitations expire after five minutes and do not reserve seats.
social.invite_error.identity-required: Verify your identity by reconnecting before sending an invitation.
social.invite_error.not-allowed: Only a connected seated player can invite; an unlisted table also requires its owner.
social.invite_error.room-not-seating: This game has started and is not accepting new players.
social.invite_error.room-full: This table has no open human seats.
social.invite_error.recipient-offline: That player is offline or cannot receive invitations. Nothing was delivered.
social.invite_error.self-invite: You cannot invite yourself or another tab with your identity.
social.invite_error.rate-limited: Too many messages or invitations. Wait a moment before trying again.
social.invite_error.inbox-full: The invitation inbox is full. Try again after older invitations expire.
replay.title: Hand Replay
replay.audit.admin_only: Audit data is visible to admins only.
